notes: Starting cards as posted under 'starting crap5': My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal ('My lord is your mom legal/yeah senator ds'), Tatooine: Desert Landing Site ('maul house'), Coruscant: Galactic Senate, Neimoidian Advisor and Watto's Box ('if ls play podrace'); these count toward the 60. Neimoidian Advisor is the starting Interrupt (STARTING: deploys an Effect that deploys on table for free), and Watto's Box is the Effect it pulls.

The title says 'TYPE-II' and the description says 'type2' (Episode I-only environment); format left as set — Bill to decide. The Coruscant-set printings are used for Galactic Senate, Naboo, Tusken Raider, Vote Now! and Alter.

The post was tagged Dark and is a Dark senate/Maul list; the draft's Light side was corrected. Section headers 'dude16' (characters), 'blue2' (starships), 'location2' and 'red35' (interrupts/effects) were removed.

Posted 'maul house' dested Tatooine: Desert Landing Site (Dark side: 'Maul deploys free here'; the objective deploys Galactic Senate and any other Episode I location); 'maul tat' dested Darth Maul (Tatooine); 'maul boat' dested Maul's Sith Infiltrator; 'blockade bridge' dested Blockade Flagship: Bridge; 'WMAOP' dested We Must Accelerate Our Plans; 'no civility' dested No Civility, Only Politics; 'the point is concede' dested The Point Is Conceded; 'squabling delegate' dested Squabbling Delegates.

Posted 'new grabbler( start against none podrace start)' dested Allegations Of Corruption, the Dark Coruscant Effect that stacks a just-played Interrupt (the 'grabber'); it deploys on table for free, so Neimoidian Advisor can start it instead of Watto's Box.

Posted 'political effect that cancel drain x2' dested This Is Outrageous!, the only Dark Political Effect printed through Coruscant that cancels a Force drain; with the separately listed 'this is outrageous' that makes 3 copies as published.

Posted 'senator x6 ... 1 of each except ask moe and is b1tch' (profanity left off the page) is left as text: six of the Dark Coruscant senators other than Lott Dod (listed separately) and Aks Moe — Baskol Yeesrim, Edcel Bar Gane, Orn Free Taa, Passel Argente, Tikkes, Toonbuck Toora, Yeb Yeb Adem'thorn — minus one the post does not name.
Neimoidian Advisor is posted once in the starting section and x2 with the interrupts (3 total, as published). Lott Dod x3 is as published.
The signature reads 'Yannick "2001 World Champion" Lapointe'; no tournament play of this list is claimed.
